svg.title: Physical AI investment orchestration architecture
svg.desc: Source architecture: company StateGraph followed by full company-report inputs, report synthesis, shared-analysis portfolio selection, fixed-score rendering and core quality plus report-reflection evaluation. This is not an execution trace.
